note: Forbidden: accepting a COOKIE2 response whose value differs from, or omits, the one sent. internal/component/ike/engine/mobike_test.go::TestMobikeCookie2ResponseControlsMigration drives the real startMobikeRequest producer. In the different and missing modes it requires out.reestablish, and it fails if f.dp.count != 0 (migration). In the match mode it requires migration (mbCheckMigration). internal/component/ike/engine/mobike_test.go::TestMobikeChangedPathStillChecksCookie2 repeats the mismatch after a path change.
